title: 2.7 Pillars of Climate Resilient Green Economy of Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia’s CRGE strategy, its four pillars, renewable energy, forests and energy-efficient technology. Hard level.

questions.question: Why does limiting cultivated land expansion reduce emissions?
options: It reduces forest clearing and soil-based emissions
It increases the use of fertilizer
questions.correctAnswer: It reduces forest clearing and soil-based emissions

questions.question: How do improved livestock practices yield combined benefits?
options: They lower incomes and raise emissions
They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions
questions.correctAnswer: They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions

questions.question: Why are forests described as providing ecosystem services?
options: They store carbon and support economic and ecological functions
questions.correctAnswer: They store carbon and support economic and ecological functions

questions.question: Why are hydro, geothermal, solar and wind attractive for Ethiopia?
options: They emit more than natural gas
They deliver electricity at virtually zero greenhouse gas emissions
questions.correctAnswer: They deliver electricity at virtually zero greenhouse gas emissions

questions.question: How does energy efficiency in buildings fit CRGE?
options: It reduces emissions through modern efficient technologies
It belongs to the agriculture pillar
questions.correctAnswer: It reduces emissions through modern efficient technologies

questions.question: How does CRGE support food security and climate goals together?
options: It separates the two goals completely
It raises farm productivity and income while cutting agricultural emissions
questions.correctAnswer: It raises farm productivity and income while cutting agricultural emissions

questions.question: Why is leapfrogging used for the technology pillar?
options: It means returning to older machines
Ethiopia can adopt modern efficient technologies directly instead of high-emission pathways
questions.correctAnswer: Ethiopia can adopt modern efficient technologies directly instead of high-emission pathways

questions.question: How does reforestation contribute to carbon sequestration?
options: Growing forests absorb and store carbon dioxide from the atmosphere
questions.correctAnswer: Growing forests absorb and store carbon dioxide from the atmosphere

questions.question: What development ambition is linked to the CRGE strategy?
How does exporting clean energy align with CRGE goals?
options: It generates income while promoting low-emission regional development
questions.correctAnswer: It generates income while promoting low-emission regional development
